_comment: Prices in USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Data, not code, so a price change is
an edit here rather than a release (PROJECT_BRIEF.md 6.2).
A model that is absent gets NO costUsd on its events. That is deliberate:
the brief says never guess a price, and a wrong number in an append-only
table is worse than no number, because it looks authoritative forever.
DeepSeek is absent on purpose -- its rates were not verifiable when this
file was written. Add them once confirmed and past events stay unpriced,
_multiplier_note: Approximate and documented as such upstream. Applied to the model's input rate.
